definition.label: Identifies as Indigenous (age 3+, private dwellings, sample estimate)
definition.universe: Usual residents of private dwellings aged 3 years and over
definition.percentageFormula: 100 * official INPI count estimate / official INPI age 3+ population estimate
definition.missingness: Unspecified identity responses remain in the denominator and are reported separately; none are recoded as No.
definition.precisionBands: High CV < 15%; moderate 15% <= CV < 30%; low CV >= 30%.
definition.overlappingIndicators: Indigenous identity may overlap Indigenous language and Afro-Mexican or Afrodescendant identity. These measures do not form an exclusive racial partition.

transformations: Exact count estimates, denominators and unspecified counts are extracted directly from INPI XLSX; no counts are inferred from rounded percentages.
Percentage = 100 * directly published count / directly published denominator.
INPI proportion/confidence interval/CV cells are fraction-valued Excel percentages; multiply by 100 for percentage units.
All confidence intervals shown in main indicator object come from INPI, the same publication as counts.

INEGI rounded shares/90% intervals are retained separately in inegiCrosscheck. Point estimates agree to 6-decimal percentage rounding; confidence limits differ slightly between publications. Do not mix the interval endpoints silently.
